## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C listing and TRA execution

- 2008-07-03: Form-of TRA filed as S-1/A Exhibit 10.4 for the deferred 2008 IPO
- 2010-03-12: Re-filed form-of TRA as S-1 Exhibit 10.5 for the 2010 U.S. listing
- 2010-07-14: TRA executed concurrent with the NYSE listing of KKR & Co. L.P., filed as 8-K Exhibit 10.3

#### Conversion period

- 2017-12-31: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act drops federal corporate rate to 21%; 2017 10-K records ~$67M gain from TRA remeasurement
- 2018-07-01: KKR & Co. L.P. converts to KKR & Co. Inc. (C-corp); KKR & Co. Inc. succeeds to all TRA obligations without amendment

#### Reorganization and termination

- 2021-10-08: Reorganization Agreement signed; Section 1.01 provides for prospective TRA termination conditional on Reorganization Mergers closing
- 2022-05-18: Final Exchange occurs
- 2022-05-30: TRA terminated prospectively
- 2022-05-31: Reorganization Mergers close; KKR Holdings L.P. merges into KKR & Co. Inc.

## Explanation

KKR & Co. L.P. executed the TRA on July 14, 2010 concurrent with its U.S. listing on the NYSE, agreeing to pay KKR Holdings L.P. (the founders' carried-interest vehicle) 85% of the cash tax savings the public corporate holdco realized from Section 754 basis step-ups generated when KKR Holdings exchanged Group Partnership Units for public Common Units. The 2018 conversion of KKR & Co. L.P. to KKR & Co. Inc. did not amend the TRA; the new C-corporation succeeded to all obligations by operation of the conversion plan, and the 2017 corporate-rate cut to 21% generated a $67M remeasurement gain. The October 8, 2021 Reorganization Agreement terminated the TRA prospectively (Section 1.01), conditional on the Reorganization Mergers closing on May 31, 2022; after the May 18, 2022 Final Exchange, no future KKR Holdings exchanges remained and the contract was extinguished for future activity effective May 30, 2022. The TRA remains a live pay-down obligation on pre-Final-Exchange exchanges: as of December 31, 2025, $359.3M of undiscounted payable was recorded and $129.4M cumulative cash had been paid. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
